vibe_rationale: Surf-town music festival tied to the Bells Beach contest week, but scale and curation are unclear and the event is on hiatus.
fit_notes: All-ages crowd, including under-18s, with weak health relevance. Its only named partner is the WSL, and no partnership contact is published, so the route is unclear. The surf-week timing is its only real link to the surf community, and the event is on hiatus.
